raw_response: {"diagnosis": "silver_transactions sums raw amount without regard to currency, so the 90 EUR rows are added into USD totals unconverted. raw_fx_rates holds a rate_to_usd for each currency (EUR 1.25, USD 1.0), so I convert in silver and the gold tables inherit the fix.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.72, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(r.txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, r.customer_id, CAST(r.merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(ROUND(CAST(r.amount AS DOUBLE) * f.rate_to_usd, 2) AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(r.txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(r.txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions r LEFT JOIN raw_fx_rates f ON f.currency = r.currency WHERE r.status = 'POSTED'"}}
